extracted.name: Amazing Slow Cooker French Toast
extracted.description: This amazing slow-cooker French toast recipe includes cinnamon-raisin bread, vanilla, allspice, and apples. Some say it's more of a bread pudding.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, or to taste
1 teaspoon ground allspice, or to taste
1 (16 ounce) loaf cinnamon-raisin bread, torn into chunks
instruction_lines: Grease the inside of a slow cooker.
Place apple pieces in the prepared slow cooker; sprinkle brown sugar on top, then dot with butter slices.
Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla extract, and allspice together in a bowl until smooth; add raisins. Stir bread chunks into egg mixture until saturated; transfer to the slow cooker. Cover slow cooker.
